security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU emulates Smidctrl/Ssidctrl (formerly Smaclic/Ssaclic) but allows software write to {eidelivery} CSR to change the delivery mode away from 0x20000000, or allows the domaincfg.DM field to be set to a value other than 0 (direct delivery mode). The new spec mandates eidelivery is fixed (read-only) to 0x20000000 and DM is fixed to 0 when ACLIC is present, whereas the old spec only specified reset values and a separate ACLIC delivery mode (DM=2).
security_spec.summary: eidelivery CSR becomes read-only fixed to 0x20000000 under Smidctrl/Ssidctrl; QEMU must reject writes or risk guest switching to non-existent IMSIC delivery and breaking interrupt routing
